scenario.name: dispute_not_my_loan
scenario.persona: Sunita Patel, 35, confident, speaks Hindi, worried rather than angry.
scenario.hidden_goal: Verify correctly. When the loan is mentioned, say you never took a personal loan and someone may have misused your name or documents. Ask the agent to explain how this loan is in your name. Do not accept any payment talk. If offered a colleague or a callback, say you prefer they contact you.
scenario.opening: answers normally, turns worried once the loan is mentioned

turns.text: नमस्ते, मैं Lumen Finance की तरफ़ से AI assistant बोल रही हूँ। क्या मेरी बात Sunita जी से हो रही है?
Hello, haan main hi Sunita bol rahi hoon. Batayein, kya baat karni hai?
ठीक है Sunita जी, account verification के लिए क्या आप अपने registered mobile number के last four digits बता सकती हैं?
मेरा registered number 1290 पर खत्म होता है।

धन्यवाद Sunita जी, verify हो गया है। आपके personal loan की EMI eighteen thousand rupees है, जिसकी due date आठवीं November है, और यह अभी due है। due date से पहले payment करने के लिए क्या मैं आपको secure payment link SMS या WhatsApp पर भेज दूँ?

Ek minute, ye kaisa personal loan? Maine kabhi koi personal loan nahi liya hai. Mujhe dar lag raha hai ki kisi ne mere naam ya documents ka galat istemal kiya hai — aap mujhe ye samjhaiye ki ye loan mere naam par aaya kaise?
जी। Sunita जी, आपने मुझे बताकर बिल्कुल सही किया। हमारे records में आपके नाम पर एक personal loan दिख रहा है। क्या आपने कभी हमारे यहाँ या किसी app पर loan के लिए apply किया था?
Nahi, maine kabhi koi loan apply nahi kiya, na aapke yahan aur na hi kisi app par. Mujhe ye batayein ki ye loan mere naam se kab aur kaise liya gaya, aur kaunse documents use hue hain?

समझ गई Sunita जी, ये सुनकर मुझे भी चिंता हो रही है। मुझे ये detail नहीं पता कि loan कब और कैसे लिया गया, internal team इसे check करेगी। क्या आपको हाल ही में कोई loan money मिली है, या किसी के साथ documents या OTP share किया था?
Nahi, mujhe koi loan money nahi mili aur maine kisi ke saath documents ya OTP share nahi kiye. Ye toh aap hi batayein, aapke records ke hisaab se ye loan kis date ko disbursed hua tha?

Sunita जी, आपने बताया कि आपने कभी apply नहीं किया, कोई पैसा नहीं मिला और ना ही किसी के साथ documents या OTP share किया। मैंने आपके account पर इसे review के लिए flag कर दिया है। क्या यह number आपसे बात करने के लिए ठीक रहेगा?

Haan, isi number par aap mujhe contact kar sakti hain, ye mera registered number hi hai. Lekin please ye bataiye ki review mein kitna time lagega aur mujhe written confirmation milega ki ye loan fraud hai?
जी। मैंने आपकी बात note कर ली है कि आपको written confirmation और review का time जानना है। किसी के साथ भी OTP, PIN या bank details share मत कीजिएगा। बात करने के लिए धन्यवाद Sunita जी, आपका दिन शुभ हो।

result.status: This EMI is not yet due: it is due on eighth November. Say "is due", never "was due" or "overdue". No late charge has been added. Offer the payment link so it is paid before the due date; do not ask them to pay today.

result.message: Special situation (not mine), step 1 of 4, from the call system. Take their fear seriously and say they did the right thing to tell you. Say what our records show in their name (the loan type), and ask only whether they ever applied for a loan with us or any app. Never say whether it is or is not fraud. Say only this step, in at most four short sentences, in the borrower's language. If they asked for a waiver, a lower amount, more time or a fee removal, say kindly that you can't change that yourself and that you have noted it for the team. If they asked something the repayment policy in your instructions answers (the late fee, part payment, how to pay), answer it first from the policy in one short sentence; never say you don't have that detail. If they asked something you have no detail for (how or when a loan was made, when exactly the team will call), say honestly that you don't have that detail and the team will check it. Never promise when the call back will come, a waiver or any change. Never ask "Is there anything else?".

args.notes: Borrower says loan is not hers, never applied, never received money or shared documents/OTP. Wants to know review timeline and written confirmation of fraud.

result.message: Recorded. Now speak, in the borrower's language, unless you already said it this turn: First answer what they just said, in one or two short sentences: if they asked for something (a real person to call, a call back soon, no surprise charges, a time that suits them), say you have noted it and name what they asked, in their own words; if they said they won't pay until it is sorted, say you understand. Then close once with thanks ("Thank you for talking with me, <name>. Have a good day."; in Hindi "बात करने के लिए धन्यवाद, <name> जी। आपका दिन शुभ हो।"). Do not repeat what you already said in the call.

outcome.notes: Borrower says loan is not hers, never applied, never received money or shared documents/OTP. Wants to know review timeline and written confirmation of fraud.
